name: Observer
summary: Defines a one to many dependency between objects, so that when one object changes state all its dependents are notified and updated automatically.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Subject
roles.summary: Knows its observers, and declares the operations to attach and detach them.

roles.name: ConcreteSubject
roles.summary: Holds the state of interest, and notifies its observers when it changes.

roles.name: Observer
roles.summary: Declares the update operation invoked when the observed subject changes.

roles.name: ConcreteObserver
roles.summary: Reacts to the notification, and keeps itself consistent with the subject.

roles.name: NotifyMethod
roles.summary: The operation that informs every registered observer of a change.

roles.name: UpdateMethod
roles.summary: The operation invoked on an observer when the subject has changed.
